create_InferenceSettings: create an InferenceSettings dataclass to configure MLIP inference with tf32, activation checkpointing, and precision options
build_inference_settings_default: build a python module to get default InferenceSettings for general MLIP inference across most systems
build_inference_settings_turbo: build a python module to get turbo InferenceSettings with tf32, compile, and merge_mole enabled for long simulations
build_inference_settings_traineval: build a python module to get traineval InferenceSettings matching the default training and evaluation configuration
run_guess_inference_settings: run guess_inference_settings to resolve a string name or InferenceSettings object into the correct settings
